name: Merge queue

template.title: Merge queue
template.summary: An integration check on the queued batch; a failure goes to a bisector that finds the change at fault and leaves the rest queued; a pass waits for a human, who lets one node land the batch.
template.whenToUse: Several reviewed changes wait to land together and the integration command (build, lint, tests) is the arbiter: insert this before the host's stop node so a batch lands only green and only on a human's word.
template.notFor: A single change (human-gated-irreversible is enough), or a host whose changes are not yet reviewed: the queue integrates, it does not review.

slots.ask: Which command integrates the queued batch and exits 0 only when it builds, lints and passes its tests?
Which file lists the queued changes and their status, in landing order?
Which command lands the queued batch, once?

credits.name: Steve Yegge's Gas Town Refinery
credits.note: a merge queue that integrates a batch, bisects on failure and lands by a human's word

description: A merge queue as a fragment. The integration check runs the integration command on the whole queued batch. On a failure a bisector splits the batch, finds the change that fails, holds it with the reason and leaves the rest queued, so the next integration is of a batch that can pass. On a pass a human gate asks, and one node carries out the land command once. The loop stops at its round cap or its dispatch budget; insert it before the host's stop node, as the human-gated-irreversible fragment is.

check.pass: exit code 0: the queued batch builds, lints and passes its tests together

nodes.name: Bisector
nodes.brief: The queued batch in {{queue-file}} fails `{{integration-command}}`: split the batch, run the integration on the parts, and find the change at fault. Hold that change in {{queue-file}} with the failure as the reason and leave every other change queued in its order; change nothing else, and fix nothing. Report what failed, how you found it and what stays queued in BISECT.md.
outputs: {{queue-file}} with the change at fault held and the rest queued
BISECT.md: the change at fault, how it was found, what stays queued

nodes.name: Land the batch
nodes.prompt: The queued batch in {{queue-file}} integrates green (BISECT.md, if present, says what was held and why). Land it now? It cannot be taken back.

nodes.name: Land
nodes.brief: Carry out `{{land-command}}` exactly once for the batch queued in {{queue-file}}. Do nothing else, and do not retry on failure; report the result instead. Write down what landed so a human can check it.
outputs: LANDING.md: what landed and the command's result
